description: Why the row is worth having at Layer 2 at all, rather than leaving `ol-repcount-outside-repeat` to the runtime. MEASURED at saga tip 904b71ac: `execute()` on this exact program reports NO diagnostic and prints `1` — it never enters a procedure nobody calls, and with no host input the `on_key` block never fires, so both defects are invisible until some later run happens to reach them. Enclosure is a purely lexical property of where the word is written (spec/execution-model.md:673-676, spec/tooling.md:195), so no execution order could make either read valid and the semantic stage is free to say so before the program runs. Deliberately NOT a check:true twin of an executing fixture: there is no executing fixture this could twin, which is the point.
